Official challenge listing page is client-rendered; verified via public search engine index and challenge brief.
Pre-hackathon research prototype; to be kept separate from official hackathon repository.
notes: Phase 01 requirements, scope, problem definition, non-goals, and traceability matrix completed and validated.

Phase 09 agentic system completed with finite-state machine orchestrator, numerical hallucination auditor, bounded explanation composer, and 9/9 tests passing.

Phase 11 frontend completed with aerospace mission control UI, 2-D decision boundary slice canvas with real NASA flight scatter points, live oxygen sweep demo, and operator safety framing.
